versions.changelog:
Initial release of Greek financial statement generation with EGLS integration and data completeness gates.

- Generates P&L, balance sheet, VAT summaries based on Greek Chart of Accounts (ΕΓΛΣ).
- Enforces strict completeness checks before statement creation; blocks output if key data is missing.
- Outputs are versioned, bilingual (Greek for clients, English internally), and provide audit trails.
- Includes human oversight flow—drafts must be reviewed before issue.
- Command set covers generation, readiness checks, amendments, comparisons, and distribution.
- No external credentials needed; processes data from a local directory.
